blind.description: A low, round ritual-style bronze cauldron or pot standing on small curved feet, featuring loop handles with rings on opposite sides. The bowl is filled to the rim with treasure, consisting of a textured mass of silver and gold coins interspersed with small rectangular gold ingots and tiny golden cups or rings. The metal has an aged, dark brass or bronze finish with hints of green oxidation.
blind.from_above: A circular bronze vessel enclosing a densely packed collection of silver and gold coins, several gold ingots, and small golden chalices or rings.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (roughly 1.3 to 1.5 feet tall) and about 1.5 to 2 feet in diameter.
